source: house-style template A "They said I'd fail" (docs/house-style, after nateassets DcP_aC_AoQz); new characters and lines for fomo
note: Fewer, longer shots, each with one clear action (18 shots in 6 clips, 2–4 a clip), so the story reads with the sound off: the conflict line with a number at 0 s and the dare at 5 s, every line cutting to the listener's face, a cold low point held long enough to land, the screens at the low point, the turn (with a ding), a wordless montage whose beats each hold long enough to read (a late night, a red day, a bigger win, then one payoff, his own studio, as one continuous action), a white flash into the time jump opening on the phone, a mirrored payoff under 8 words, the scream, and the end line with Malik holding his phone up to the camera, the fomo logo clear, to close.
input:
<brand>
Brand: fomo
Required screens. Every shot at one of these moments shows the matching screen, attached as a reference image: keep its UI, logo and layout; the coin, numbers and chart are what the shot says:
- screen:1 "Home" (mobile, home) — required at: fomo-mention, app-open
- screen:2 "Token chart up" (mobile, trading, chart-up) — required at: trading, win
- screen:3 "Token chart down" (mobile, trading, chart-down) — required at: trading, loss
- screen:4 "Desktop trading" (desktop, trading) — required at: trading-desktop
Moments: app-open, fomo-mention, loss, trading, trading-desktop, win
</brand>
<cast>
char:1 Malik, 17, red beanie, grey hoodie, headphones round his neck
char:2 Aunt Tasha, his aunt, neat bob, cardigan
</cast>
<places>
place:1 Tasha's kitchen
place:2 Malik's small bedroom
</places>
<video_model>Seedance 2.5: 4–30 s per clip, up to 30 reference images (prefer 8 or fewer)</video_model>
<script>
1| SCENE 1 — INT. KITCHEN — DAY
2| Aunt Tasha slams Malik's empty piggy bank on the counter.
3| TASHA: Your college fund is EMPTY?! Five hundred dollars!
4| MALIK: I put it in fomo.
5| TASHA: A phone app? That's your college money!
6| MALIK: Thirty days. Watch me.
7| TASHA: Thirty days. Then you're bagging groceries.
8| SCENE 2 — INT. MALIK'S BEDROOM — NIGHT
9| ★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on Malik's phone
10| Malik drops his head onto his arms in the blue phone glow.
11| MALIK: Come on. One more.
12| ★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Malik's phone in his hand, a phone ding
13| Wordless montage, Malik in every shot: the grind first, then getting rich. Another late night with the energy cans, a red day he shakes off, a bigger win on his new desktop; then one payoff, his own studio: a delivery box of studio gear he rips open there, then Malik behind his own mixing desk as his first track blasts.
14| ★ fomo screen: Desktop trading — on his monitor
15| SCENE 3 — INT. KITCHEN — DAY, ONE MONTH LATER
16| White flash. The red piggy bank sits on the counter.
17| Malik slides his phone across the counter.
18| TASHA: That's… real?
19| MALIK: Still want me bagging groceries?
20| Tasha grabs his phone with both hands and screams.
21| MALIK: Want to trade like me? Download fomo through the link in my bio.
22| ★ fomo screen: Home — Malik holds his phone up to the camera, the fomo logo clear
</script>

output.hook: Tasha slams Malik's empty piggy bank down at 0 s, and the money ($500) is in her first line; his dare lands at second 5.

scenes.heading: INT. KITCHEN — DAY
scenes.look: Warm day interior: soft window key, warm bounce on faces, cool grey-blue walls; the red piggy bank is the one saturated object.

shots.speaker: Tasha
shots.line: Your college fund is EMPTY?! Five hundred dollars!
shots.action: Tasha slams the empty piggy bank on the counter.
shots.camera: Close-up on Tasha, the piggy bank rocking in the foreground, push in

shots.speaker: Malik
shots.action: Malik lifts his phone toward her, the fomo home screen in his hand.
shots.camera: Over Tasha's shoulder, low-angle close-up on Malik and the phone in his hand, slow push in

shots.speaker: Tasha
shots.line: A phone app? That's your college money!
shots.action: Tasha jabs a finger at the phone.
shots.reaction: Furious he gambled the college money: brows crash into a hard V.
shots.camera: Close-up on Tasha, whip pan from Malik

shots.speaker: Malik
shots.action: Malik steps in, nose to nose with her.
shots.camera: Profile two-shot, nose to nose, slow orbit

shots.speaker: Tasha
shots.line: Thirty days. Then you're bagging groceries.

shots.reaction: Scared she might be right, too proud to show it: a tight swallow, jaw set.

scenes.heading: INT. MALIK'S BEDROOM — NIGHT, THEN MONTAGE: HIS OWN STUDIO
scenes.look: Near black, cold blue phone light from below, until the win turns it green and warm; the grind stays at night in his room (blue light, energy cans, the clock); the payoff climbs into warm gold: the amber desk lights of his own studio, gold light filling it as the track plays.

shots.action: Over Malik's shoulder the token falls on the phone in his hand: the position reads -$380; his head sinks onto his arms.
shots.reaction: Crushed, the bet looks lost: shoulders sag, eyes shut.
shots.camera: Over-the-shoulder close-up on the phone in his hand, slow tilt down as his head drops

shots.speaker: Malik
shots.action: Malik lifts his head and taps the screen, his face in the blue glow.
Malik's hand grips his phone as the token rockets up with a phone ding: the position reads +$420 (+38%), green light on his face.
shots.reaction: Hopeful the bet is turning at last: a slow grin.
shots.camera: Close-up on Malik's hand holding the phone, his face above it, snap zoom in on the ding

shots.action: Another late night: at 3 a.m. Malik's thumb scrolls the coin list and taps Buy, energy cans stacking up beside him, eyes red in the phone's glow.
shots.camera: Medium close-up, slow track along the desk

shots.action: A red day: Malik tosses his phone onto the desk, hands over his face, then snatches it back up.
shots.camera: Close-up, quick tilt down to the phone and back up

shots.action: A bigger win: at his new desktop setup Malik pumps his fist as the monitor shows the fomo desktop trading screen; the balance reads $12,400.
shots.camera: Over-the-shoulder close-up on the monitor, push in

shots.action: In his own studio Malik rips open a delivery box of studio gear, spins into the chair behind his mixing desk and slams the faders up as his first track blasts, gold light filling the room.
shots.camera: Medium shot, orbit round the chair

scenes.heading: INT. KITCHEN — DAY, ONE MONTH LATER
scenes.look: The same kitchen in golden-hour sun with a strong rim on both faces; warmer and richer than before.

shots.action: White flash onto the red piggy bank on the counter; Malik's hand slides his phone in beside it and leaves it in front of Tasha, the fomo home screen's portfolio balance reading $512,400 (the time card goes over it in post).
shots.camera: Overhead close-up on the counter, track with the phone

shots.speaker: Tasha
shots.reaction: Stunned it's real, the doubt draining away: she goes still, then looks up at him.

shots.speaker: Malik
shots.action: Malik leans on the counter, calm.
shots.reaction: Quietly proud he proved her wrong: a small smirk.

shots.action: Tasha grabs his phone with both hands and screams with joy.
shots.reaction: Overjoyed for him, the doubt gone: she clutches the phone to her chest, bouncing on her toes.
shots.camera: Whip pan to a medium close-up on Tasha

shots.speaker: Malik
shots.line: Want to trade like me? Download fomo through the link in my bio.
shots.action: Malik takes his phone back and holds it up to the camera beside his grin, screen toward the lens; the fomo home screen's logo is sharp and its portfolio balance reads $512,400.
shots.camera: Medium close-up, Malik facing the camera, slow push in onto the phone

clips.seam: Tasha's jab hangs in the air; Malik steps in to answer it.
Hard cut on Malik's set jaw to his bedroom that night.
The ding carries over the cut into the grind, the same night.
White flash into one month later; the time card is added in post over the piggy bank.
Malik's smirk holds; Tasha's grab answers it.
